name: V3 Ferengi and Orion population restart persistence
description: Runs after the acceptance harness restarts the serving V3 game server; checks targets, unique identities, and preserved ship state in the same disposable PostgreSQL database.

tests.name: Ferengi and Orion target populations persist without duplicate ship identities

data.sql: WITH universe AS (SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS sectors FROM sectors), fcfg AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT value::int FROM config WHERE key='ferengi.population.percent'),2) AS pct), ftarget AS (SELECT GREATEST(3,CEIL(universe.sectors*fcfg.pct/100.0)::int) AS n FROM universe CROSS JOIN fcfg), ocfg AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT value::int FROM config WHERE key='orion.population.basis_points'),50) AS bp,COALESCE((SELECT value::int FROM config WHERE key='orion.population.minimum'),5) AS minimum), otarget AS (SELECT GREATEST(ocfg.minimum,CEIL(universe.sectors*ocfg.bp/10000.0)::int) AS n FROM universe CROSS JOIN ocfg), f AS (SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n,COUNT(DISTINCT ship_id)::int AS distinct_n FROM ferengi_traders WHERE active=TRUE), o AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.ship_id)::int AS n FROM ships s JOIN ship_ownership so USING(ship_id) JOIN corp_members cm USING(player_id) JOIN corporations c USING(corporation_id) WHERE c.tag='ORION' AND so.is_primary=TRUE AND COALESCE(s.destroyed,FALSE)=FALSE) SELECT CASE WHEN f.n=ftarget.n AND f.distinct_n=f.n AND o.n=otarget.n THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM f,o,ftarget,otarget;

tests.name: Established NPC ship state survives server restart and startup reconciliation

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ships WHERE hull=77 AND shields=33 AND fighters=42)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ships WHERE hull=76 AND shields=34 AND fighters=41)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Orion captain ownership remains consistent with active ship sector

data.sql: WITH universe AS (SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS sectors FROM sectors), cfg AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT value::int FROM config WHERE key='orion.population.basis_points'),50) AS bp,COALESCE((SELECT value::int FROM config WHERE key='orion.population.minimum'),5) AS minimum), target AS (SELECT GREATEST(cfg.minimum,CEIL(universe.sectors*cfg.bp/10000.0)::int) AS n FROM universe CROSS JOIN cfg), active AS (SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n,COALESCE(BOOL_AND(p.sector_id=s.sector_id),FALSE) AS sectors_match FROM ships s JOIN ship_ownership so ON so.ship_id=s.ship_id AND so.is_primary=TRUE JOIN players p ON p.player_id=so.player_id AND p.is_npc=TRUE JOIN corp_members cm ON cm.player_id=p.player_id JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=cm.corporation_id AND c.tag='ORION' WHERE COALESCE(s.destroyed,FALSE)=FALSE) SELECT CASE WHEN active.n=target.n AND active.sectors_match THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM active,target;
